# A32-S62: Correspondence

Edited source text. [████] marks omissions.

[████]
[████]

[████]

I have been allowed to showcase both DSP/LederLars – who has emphasized that "he" speaks French, English, and Arabic – and who is also looking forward to coming to [████] 😃 I have just been sitting and reading old blogs on Medium – the discussion with OpenAI is still fantastic – you built DSP on GPT3, got forbidden – what did you do then? Then you updated the open source platform you used, to not accept anything with politics, then you put DSP somewhere where Leder Lars was grumpy and rude and then moved him to where he is now – and where is that – now he is super jovial and can speak all languages 😃 What a journey.
